text:
Jorge: Kicking off tenant shadow-sync for migration 2026_04_add_settings_col at 03:00 UTC. Canary on tenant range 1000-1999. small roll, watch for deadlocks.
Priya: Copying deploy checklist: pinned migration version 20260401_v2, feature flag ff.new-settings off by default, will flip after backfill validation.
Lina: Preflight: canary applied to 2 replicas, read-only traffic mirror in place, no schema diffs on replicas. all ok. :white_check_mark:
deploy-bot: Deploy job started 03:00:12 UTC. canary -> 10% for 5m -> 50% -> 100% per plan. job id: deploy-1741239999.
Jorge: Important: backfill (shadow_sync_2026_04) will run in tenant batches of 250 tenants, pause between batches 120s. throttle at 150 qps.
db-ops-bot: Monitoring locks and deadlocks. alert if deadlocks > 1 in 60s.
Priya: If we see deadlocks, immediate action is to pause the backfill and toggle ff.new-settings=false. rollback migration only as last resort.
Lina: Canary at 10% now. initial checks: p95 write latency +12ms, error rate 0.04%.
deploy-bot: 03:05:20 -> canary 10% stable, advancing to 50%.
Jorge: Note: tenant 1234 previously had long-running compact job. exclude from first batch. I'll add to skip list.
Priya: A heads-up: pinned binary version is 1.12.3-r2 for this rollout. if we need to rollback, we will pin back to 1.12.2 and reapply connection-hints.
Lina: 03:09:47 advancing to 50%. no regressions visible.
db-ops-bot: Observed a transient deadlock on shard 12 at 03:12:10. count=1. no escalation yet.
Jorge: Pausing backfill at 03:12:30 to investigate. leaving deploy at 50% while we check.
Priya: Can we resume without toggling flag? Check the query fingerprint: `UPDATE settings SET value = $1 WHERE user_id = $2` was the culprit. Might need to reduce batch size for shard 12.
Lina: Reducing batch size for affected shard to 100 tenants and increasing inter-batch delay to 300s.
db-ops-bot: After adjustments, deadlocks cleared.
deploy-bot: Backfill resumed at 03:18:10 with new batch config.
Jorge: Reminder: abort conditions we agreed: sustained error rate >0.5% for 3m OR deadlock rate > 0.2% for 5m OR replica lag > 5s.
Priya: Pager on call: PagerDuty -> Lina -> Jorge. If abort triggers, Lina pages immediately and flips ff.new-settings=false, then we evaluate pinch rollback.
Lina: Observing a small increase in CPU on worker nodes at 03:23 but under 78% limit. fine.
Priya: Logging note: recorded canary variables and metrics at https://internal.redwood/releases/1741239999/logs. please add any postmortem notes there.
Jorge: After two batches completed, customers in tenant range 2000-2499 scheduled for next window. will coordinate separately.
db-ops-bot: Final batch completed at 03:46:02. backfill job id bf-1741239999 finished with 0.06% errors.
Lina: Post-cutover validations: sample read/write checks against updated schema passed for 20 random tenants.
Priya: Preparing release note draft: "2026-04-03 migration 2026_04_add_settings_col applied; shadow-sync completed with one paused batch for shard 12; no rollback required. pinned binary remained 1.12.3-r2."
Jorge: I'll open a short follow-up to remove tenant 1234 from auto-batches until compact job finishes.
deploy-bot: Deploy job complete at 03:50:00 UTC.
Priya: Posting release note now and updating runbook with the shard-12 mitigation steps.
Lina: Thanks team. closing thread but keep pager active for 2hr post-rollout.
PagerDuty: Pager rotation acknowledged.
Jorge: Good job.
